text: The import telemetry discussion first proposes counting an early-abandoned profile import as failed. The author then explicitly withdraws that proposal because the import was not attempted. The actual addition records unzipFailed in the separate extraction catch within ProfileImporterController.startImport; backend failures use failed. Existing changed tests add success-event assertions and do not add a failed or unzipFailed assertion. Keep the corrected historical metric scope and the reviewer’s remaining failure-test request separate. This is a specific collection decision, not a universal definition of failure. Static source only; no import or telemetry test ran.
title: Import review withdraws counting preflight abandonment as failure
